recommendation: This site shows a moderate heat priority. The assessed intervention represents a moderate NbS cooling opportunity. Urban woodland (site) is expected to deliver an indicative daytime air temperature reduction of 1.0-2.42 C at pedestrian level, principally through continuous canopy shade + evapotranspiration. IMPORTANT: this typology is not suitable for this site (site area 900 m2 is below the minimum viable area of 2000 m2 for Urban woodland (site); soil availability 'limited' is below the typology requirement 'moderate'; irrigation availability 'none' is below the typology requirement 'occasional'). The scores below are reported for transparency but the intervention as specified is unlikely to be viable without addressing these conditions first. Cooling-energy savings were not calculated (it was not confirmed that nearby building cooling demand is relevant to this intervention). Capital cost, payback and cost feasibility were not estimated because no cost input was supplied. This tool ships no default cost values. Data completeness for this assessment is low; treat the result as a screening signal for further investigation rather than a conclusion.
method_note: Results are screening-level estimates based on simplified typology factors and user-provided assumptions. They are not microclimate simulation outputs. Detailed design, local climate analysis and maintenance planning are required before implementation. All cooling estimates are daytime values; nighttime effects are substantially smaller and are not estimated by this tool.
